messages:
carl: Heads-up — customer reported what looks like two charges from a single user flow: streaming response truncated, client retried, and a tool call appears twice in billing. Minimal logs attached.
mira: Thanks. Is this during a regional routing fallback or simple reconnect?
hao: Trace shows a route-change: us-west -> gpu-8bit in us-east. Router emitted a route.swap event which clears ephemeral session headers. Client reconnects immediately and replays the last turn.
carl: Log excerpt: ```2026-03-22T18:45:02Z stream EOF seq=512; queued toolcall id=tc-202; 2026-03-22T18:45:03Z router: route.swap -> clear-ephemeral; 2026-03-22T18:45:03Z reconnect: replay -> toolcall id=tc-202-R```
mira: Two parallel tracks: (A) push clients to include explicit session_id/idempotency on retries, (B) server-side fallback to avoid duplicate provisional billing when client info is missing. We need short-term safety net.
hao: For server fallback we can compute a lightweight dedupe_hash = blake2b(normalize(tool_payload) + tool_name + customer_id) and use that for provisional-charge suppression if we see a matching recent provisional within a short TTL (300-700ms).
carl: Important constraints: 1) never drop raw events (must be immutable); 2) suppression should create a linked suppression_record, not delete; 3) customers must be able to opt-out.
mira: Add defensive checks: only suppress when prior event state == PROVISIONAL and reconnect was within X ms OR a route.swap flag is present. Also require same origin_ip approximate to avoid colliding parallel requests.
hao: Agree. We'll also emit telemetry flags: dedupe_hash, dedupe_applied=true/false, dedupe_rule=route_swap|short_reconnect, dedupe_action=suppressed|annotated. Trace ids should be surfaced in console.
console-ui: UX: propose an inline tag: "Provisional (heuristic)" with hover copy: "Temporarily suppressed provisional charge due to suspected retry. Click to view linked raw events and trace." Add an action: "Open dedupe trace" -> links to trace id. Also add a filter for "Suppressed provisional charges" in billing UI.
carl: We should offer an annotate-only mode for first rollout: flag `annotate_only=true` will mark events but not suppress. Ops can validate before flipping to active suppression.
mira: Also need per-customer control: customer_metadata.has_flag("no_server_dedupe") to skip suppression. Add global feature-flag `server_retry_safety_dedupe` with kill switch.
hao: On implementation: index dedupe_hash in provisional_events table for quick lookup, TTL index for expiry ~1s. To preserve replayability, always store the second event raw and write a suppression_record {original_event_id, duplicate_event_id, dedupe_hash, policy, actor}. We'll keep suppression_record as a separate table.
carl: Tests: unit tests for collisions, integration tests simulating route.swap + reconnect bursts, and a backfill job to compute dedupe_hash for last 7 days to estimate collision rate before turning suppression on.
mira: Alerting: trigger page if dedupe_suppressed_rate > 0.4% of retries or if confirmed_charge_delta (post-reconciliation) increases. Also dashboard showing suppressed_count, total_retries, suppressed/confirmed ratio.
hao: Telemetry schema: emit into events table fields `dedupe.hash`, `dedupe.policy`, `dedupe.applied`, `dedupe.annotate_only`, `dedupe.trace_link`. Keep raw events intact so billing can replay if needed.
console-ui: For the billing console, show suppressed events visually but with muted color and the badge. Provide an "Audit" action that creates a billing ticket with the two raw event IDs attached.
carl: Compliance note: customers under strict audit regimes may prefer no automated server dedupe. Ensure per-customer opt-out honored and documented.
mira: Rollout plan: 1) backfill and collision analysis (3 days), 2) enable annotate-only canary at 5% in non-critical region for 48h, 3) if metrics good, enable suppression gradually with per-customer opt-out respected.
hao: I'll own server patch + suppression_record table + tests. ETA 10 days.
carl: I'll own RFC and the canary plan.
console-ui: We'll mock the badge and audit flow; prototype screenshots by EOW.
mira: I'll build telemetry dashboards and alerts; ETA 4 days.
billing-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-29 12:00 UTC (5% traffic, annotate-only). Metric gates: suppressed_count / retry_count < 0.5% and no uptick in confirmed_charge_delta over 48h.
carl: Final reminder: keep suppression reversible and fully auditable. If we ever mis-suppress we must be able to replay billing events and refund. Document rollback playbook in RFC.
hao: Noted. We'll keep raw events immutable and provide replay endpoints for billing ops.
mira: OK — moving this to ticket RW-11258: "stream-retry metadata preservation + provisional-billing heuristic". Please add ETAs and link UI mocks.
carl: Thanks team — ping this thread when backfill completes.
console-ui: We'll post UI mocks in RW-11258 by Friday.
carl: Closing thread for now.
